output: Deterministic evaluation with citation and context
review_or_abstention_boundary: No new operator interpretation; reject malformed data

input_condition: Known alias and finite grammar with explicit days/hours/actors
output: Create draft with source spans; validate boundaries/types
review_or_abstention_boundary: Ambiguous wording or new meaning => unresolved
implementation_tradeoff: Fast reproducible ingestion; fragile outside approved grammar

output: Draft concept/actor/action/condition/scope; retain original source and confidence
review_or_abstention_boundary: Confidence cannot authorize rule/gate; new meanings require review
implementation_tradeoff: Run at ingestion, not 500ms path; constrained schema, no tools

input_condition: Ambiguity, conflict, clinical meaning, novel operator or gate
output: Approve exact structured rule/version and scope or reject
implementation_tradeoff: Required for production local authority; offline queue

input_condition: Document uploaded as untrusted source data
output: Hash/version/source field -> extraction -> approved concept mapping -> structured draft -> validation -> supported execution OR review/abstain
review_or_abstention_boundary: No code/eval/tool command generated from source content
implementation_tradeoff: Raw document immutable; encounter and review logs separate

input_condition: Different name/value versus new rule meaning
output: Approved alias maps automatically; unknown literal can be cited on demand; unknown action logic shows source and unsupported flag
review_or_abstention_boundary: Data-only extensibility covers schema/content, not unbounded clinical execution
implementation_tradeoff: For same-format unseen hospital load via data; no hardcoded hospital branches
